item.title: NES CPU Compiled into Qwen Weights to Run Games In-Model
item.description:
The nesformer project compiles the NES 6502 CPU, RAM, and ROM logic directly into standard Qwen3.5 model weights without training, enabling in-model simulation. By leveraging Gated DeltaNet states as machine memory, the LLM predicts CPU execution logs token-by-token, allowing classic games like Super Mario Bros. to run entirely within approximately 1GB of weight space.

原文标题：Qwen 权重编译 NES CPU 实现模型内运行游戏

Why it matters：展示了大模型权重作为通用计算载体的极限可能性，具有极高的技术趣味性与架构创新价值。

item.title: Subvocal Launches Radar Glasses for Silent Speech-to-Text Input
item.description:
Startup Subvocal has launched smart glasses using non-contact radar sensing to decode silent mouth movements into text at over 200 words per minute. This technology addresses privacy and noise issues inherent in voice dictation by tracking internal speech muscles without requiring audible sound or physical typing. The product is currently available for pre-order following a $1.3M funding round.

原文标题：Subvocal 发布雷达眼镜 实现无声口述转文字

Why it matters：将“脸变成键盘”的交互范式落地，显著提升了私密场景下的输入效率，具备较高的硬件创新关注度。

item.title: US Tech Stocks Slide on AI Cost Concerns
item.description:
US tech stocks slid sharply as concerns intensified over the rising costs of AI infrastructure build-out. Intel shares plunged after warning of a weaker computer market despite plans to increase AI spending, while Amazon's earnings miss further pressured the Nasdaq to a two-month low. Analysts note that major tech players are experiencing significant growing pains in their aggressive AI pursuits, fueling fears of a sector-wide slowdown.

原文标题：AI 基建成本担忧致美股科技股大跌

Why it matters：反映 AI 资本开支压力对传统科技巨头估值与盈利预期的实质性冲击。

item.description:

The strategy reuses the weapons jailbreak detection stack, employing internal activation probes and concept vector distance algorithms to identify runtime behavior and asset similarities even after code renaming.

item.title: Intel Fab 28 Explosion Halts Production for Two Weeks, Causing $600M Revenue Loss
item.description:
Intel's Fab 28 in Kiryat Gat halted production for two weeks following an explosion, primarily impacting 10nm-class server chip manufacturing. CFO Dave Zinsner estimated a $300 million revenue loss in both Q4 and Q1, alongside a 200 basis point hit to gross margins. Production is set to resume by the weekend, though full capacity restoration remains uncertain.

原文标题：英特尔 Fab 28 爆炸致停产两周，预计损失 6 亿美元营收

Why it matters：重大基础设施事故直接冲击核心算力供应链与财务表现，对行业格局有显著短期影响。

item.title: Tangled Launches First Federated Code Forge
item.description:
Open-source project Tangled has launched the first federated code forge built on the AT Protocol, aiming to combine Git's longevity with a polished user experience. The platform supports modular self-hosting, allowing users to deploy only necessary components like Git or CI while maintaining seamless cross-server collaboration.

item.title: Arena.ai: Missing Cache Increases Agent Costs by 260%
item.description:
Arena.ai analyzed over 26K agent sessions, revealing that removing prompt caching increases typical task costs by 260%. For models like Claude Fable 5.1, a single task's cost jumps from $7.44 to $27 without caching, while cache invalidation adds another 5% to bills. The study highlights the critical role of caching in optimizing agent economics.

原文标题：Arena.ai 分析：缓存缺失致智能体成本激增 260%

Why it matters：量化了缓存对智能体运行成本的决定性影响，为开发者优化推理预算提供了直接的数据支撑。

Leveraging the NVIDIA Holoscan platform for real-time sensor data processing, these AI agents automatically handle instrument steering, data enhancement, and model inference, significantly boosting search efficiency and adaptability.

item.title: Intel Shares Plunge Over 30% on Weak Q4 Guidance and PC Slump
item.description:
Intel shares plummeted over 30%, wiping out more than $137 billion in market cap, potentially marking the largest single-day drop in history. The crash was driven by fourth-quarter revenue guidance significantly below analyst expectations and warnings that a weak PC market and rising memory costs will persist into early 2027. Despite year-over-year growth in Q3 revenue, negative cash flow and supply disruptions from an Israeli factory incident have intensified investor concerns regarding Intel's ability to meet data center demand for AI chips.

原文标题：英特尔股价暴跌超 30% 创历史纪录 因业绩指引不及预期

item.title: Altman Addresses AI Math Backlash: Admits Publication Flaws but Stays the Course
item.description:
Sam Altman addressed mathematicians' backlash against OpenAI's research publications, admitting flaws in rigor and context while promising better integration with the academic community. Despite protests from Fields Medalists and controversy over withholding Yang-Mills theory details, he affirmed that humanity deserves to understand fundamental laws and will not halt scientific progress. OpenAI also pledged $5 million to the Simons Foundation to help mathematicians adapt to AI-generated discoveries.

原文标题：奥尔特曼回应 AI 数学争议：承认发布方式待改进但坚持推进研究

item.title: Xiaomi Open-Sources 0.8B OCR Model for Document Parsing and VQA
item.description:
Xiaomi has open-sourced Xiaomi-OCR-0, a lightweight document understanding model built on the Qwen3.5-0.8B base. This single-model architecture covers document parsing, key information extraction, and OCR visual question answering, natively supporting Markdown, LaTeX, and JSON outputs. The training process employs a heterogeneous expert consensus mechanism and a 'predict-re-render-compare' closed-loop verification to significantly enhance accuracy in complex tables, formulas, and long-tail scenarios.
